message.content: Since visible swelling and respiratory infection are absent, consider muscular tension or strain, stress-related neck tightness, cervical spine misalignment, or local inflammation from a minor strain. A sore throat may result from postnasal drip, reflux irritation, mild pharyngitis, or voice overuse. Perceived neck fullness may be muscle spasm, tender lymph nodes not yet visibly enlarged, or anxiety/somatic sensation. Check recent injury, posture, fever, dysphagia, breathing changes, or rash. If symptoms persist, worsen, or include difficulty swallowing or breathing, seek urgent evaluation.
